summary: Implementation plan to upgrade VitaeFlow AI Resume Builder into a modern CV Studio featuring optional profile photo uploads with circular/square/hidden controls, zoom & pan sliders, Google Fonts typography pairings (Lato, Inter, Roboto, Playfair Display, and optional decorative calligraphy headings), 6 structurally distinct A4 resume templates (Modern, Executive, Split Column, Creative, Professional, Elegant), multi-color palette and custom Primary/Accent/Heading color pickers in both the Resume Builder toolbar and Templates studio, a collapsible left sidebar on desktop + slide-out drawer on mobile with a top Back button on internal pages, removal of the promotional footer on internal workspace pages, and 1:1 A4 preview + PDF export improvements.
